default.question: What certifications do you offer in Project Management?
default.answer: We offer PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, and PgMP certifications.

default.question: Do you provide exam vouchers?
default.answer: Yes, many of our courses include exam vouchers. Please check specific course details.

default.question: Is the training online or classroom-based?
default.answer: We offer both live online instructor-led training and self-paced learning options.

pmp-certification.question: What are the prerequisites for PMP?
pmp-certification.answer: You need a 4-year degree + 36 months of leading projects OR a high school diploma + 60 months of leading projects, plus 35 hours of PM education.

pmp-certification.question: Does this course include the 35 PDUs?
pmp-certification.answer: Yes, our PMP training provides the required 35 Contact Hours/PDUs.

pmp-certification.question: What is the PMP exam fee?
pmp-certification.answer: The exam fee is paid directly to PMI. It is typically $405 for members and $555 for non-members.

prince2-foundation-practitioner.question: What is the difference between Foundation and Practitioner?
prince2-foundation-practitioner.answer: Foundation covers the basic methodology, while Practitioner focuses on applying it to real scenarios.

prince2-foundation-practitioner.question: Is the exam included?
prince2-foundation-practitioner.answer: Yes, our PRINCE2 bundle usually includes vouchers for both exams.

prince2-foundation-practitioner.question: How long is the access valid?
prince2-foundation-practitioner.answer: You will have access to course materials for 1 year.
